title: Authentic Mexican Pork or Chicken Pozole Rojo
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder (cut into cubes) or bone-in chicken thighs/breasts
2 cans (25 oz each) white hominy, drained and rinsed
4 dried guajillo chiles & 3 dried ancho chiles, stemmed, seeded, and softened in hot water
1 white onion (half for broth, half for blending) + 6 cloves garlic
1.5 tsp Mexican oregano & 1 tsp ground cumin
8 cups pork or chicken broth, 2 bay leaves, kosher salt
Garnishes: shredded green cabbage, thinly sliced radishes, diced white onion, cilantro, oregano, lime wedges, and tostadas
instructions: Simmer the pork shoulder (or chicken) in 8 cups of water/broth with half an onion, 3 garlic cloves, bay leaves, and salt for 60 minutes until tender.
Blend the rehydrated guajillo and ancho chiles with half an onion, 3 garlic cloves, cumin, oregano, and 1.5 cups soaking liquid until silky smooth; strain through a sieve.
Fry the strained red chile sauce in 1 tbsp oil in a hot pot for 5 minutes to deepen flavor, then pour into the pork/chicken broth along with the rinsed white hominy.
Simmer together for 25–30 minutes until the hominy is plump and the red broth is rich. Serve in deep bowls piled with shredded cabbage, radishes, lime, and tostadas.
